import numpy as np

def feature(pos, targets, values, rates, battery, drain, charge_rate, charger, time, time_left, history):
    """Endgame one-way commitment: for items whose arrival value beats the value at risk if the drone must abandon mid-trip, score = (arrival value - battery-stranded penalty value) / outbound time, only when a return to the charger is no longer affordable; 0 otherwise (including the charger row)."""
    d = np.linalg.norm(targets - pos, axis=1)
    is_item = values > 0

    d_back = np.linalg.norm(charger[None, :] - targets, axis=1)
    # energy needed to fly out and get back to the charger afterwards
    return_need = (d + d_back) * drain
    # can we still return after touching this item?
    can_return = return_need <= battery

    # outbound energy; if the battery dies before arrival we lose everything
    out_energy = d * drain
    reaches = out_energy <= battery

    # projected value at arrival, and the extra decay we eat because the trip is one-way (no recharge detour helps)
    v_arr = np.maximum(values - rates * d, 0.0)

    # value we would have collected if we could have also gone back and recharged: the trip already spent this much battery
    recharge_t_one_way = out_energy / np.maximum(charge_rate, 1e-6)
    # a one-way trip buys us (time_left - d) of extra flying at speed 1, converted to reachable distance
    spare_time = np.maximum(time_left - d, 0.0)
    reach_bonus = np.minimum(spare_time, 0.5)  # capped: beyond this, decay dominates

    # endgame gate: only active when a full return is NOT affordable, but the item is reachable
    endgame = (~can_return) & reaches & is_item

    # stranded cost: the penalty (40) risked, weighted by how close we are to running dry
    batt_margin_at_item = battery - out_energy
    strand_risk = np.clip(1.0 - batt_margin_at_item / 0.30, 0.0, 1.0)

    # net value rate: arrival value plus the reach bonus (opportunity of the rest of the endgame) minus stranded penalty cost
    net = v_arr + reach_bonus * np.maximum(rates, 0.0) - 40.0 * strand_risk * 0.0
    # scale penalty by drain so it reflects real risk, not a constant
    net = v_arr + reach_bonus * np.maximum(rates, 0.0) - 40.0 * strand_risk * np.clip(drain, 0.0, 1.0)

    score = np.where(endgame, net / (d + 0.05), 0.0)
    # charger row and any non-endgame row are 0, so the endgame choice is made purely by item comparison
    scale = float(np.max(np.abs(score))) if score.size else 1.0
    scale = max(scale, 1e-6)
    return np.clip(score / scale, -1.0, 1.0)

import numpy as np

def feature(pos, targets, values, rates, battery, drain, charge_rate, charger, time, time_left, history):
    """Charger row: opportune recharge pull = battery deficit times the value density that will appear-pool during the recharge (estimated from history's appearance rate), so recharging is favoured when the future looks rich; items 0."""
    k = len(values)
    is_item = values > 0
    out = np.zeros(k, dtype=float)

    # estimate appearance rate and mean value/rate from history (columns: x, y, t_appear, value0, rate)
    if history.shape[0] >= 3:
        t_app = history[:, 2]
        span = max(time - t_app.min(), 1e-3)
        appear_rate = history.shape[0] / span  # items per time unit
        v0 = history[:, 3]
        rr = np.maximum(history[:, 4], 1e-6)
        # typical "value density" of an item: peak value per unit of its lifetime
        dens = v0 * rr  # value units per time (max value bleed per time at start)
        mean_dens = float(np.mean(np.clip(dens, 0.0, None)))
    else:
        appear_rate = 1.0
        mean_dens = 1.0

    # expected value pool (per unit time) recoverable if we charge now:
    # recharge duration for current deficit
    deficit = np.clip(1.0 - battery, 0.0, 1.0)
    recharge_t = deficit / max(charge_rate, 1e-3)
    # during recharge, this much value appears and is at risk of being missed
    pool_rate = appear_rate * mean_dens
    # only meaningful while there is time to make use of it, and only at the charger row
    horizon_ok = np.clip(time_left / max(recharge_t + 1.0, 1e-3), 0.0, 1.0)

    # normalise into a soft signal in [-1, 1]
    raw = np.log1p(pool_rate * recharge_t) * horizon_ok
    out[~is_item] = np.tanh(1.0 * raw - 0.5 * deficit)  # deficit also self-pulls a bit
    return out

import numpy as np

def feature(pos, targets, values, rates, battery, drain, charge_rate, charger, time, time_left, history):
    """Per item: the value density of the *worst-case* leg of a two-leg tour (this item then the best follow-up), where each leg's density is discounted by the recharge it forces and by how close the end of the horizon is; charger scored by how much reachable value is about to vanish uncollected."""
    d = np.linalg.norm(targets - pos[None, :], axis=1)
    is_item = values > 0
    k = len(values)

    life = values / np.maximum(rates, 1e-9)
    surv_here = np.where(is_item, np.maximum(values - rates * d, 0.0), 0.0)

    # pairwise travel times between candidates
    diff = targets[:, None, :] - targets[None, :, :]
    T = np.linalg.norm(diff, axis=2)
    Ts = d[:, None] + T                       # time from now to item j via item i
    surv2 = values[None, :] * np.clip(1.0 - Ts / np.maximum(life[None, :], 1e-9), 0.0, 1.0)
    surv2 = np.where(is_item[None, :] & is_item[:, None] & ~np.eye(k, dtype=bool), surv2, 0.0)

    # per-leg recharge amortisation: energy each leg spends, discounted by remaining horizon
    horizon = np.maximum(time_left, 1e-3)
    leg1_energy = d * drain
    leg2_energy = T * drain
    amort1 = (leg1_energy / np.maximum(charge_rate, 1e-6)) * (1.0 - np.clip(leg1_energy / np.maximum(charge_rate, 1e-6) / horizon, 0.0, 1.0))
    amort2 = (leg2_energy / np.maximum(charge_rate, 1e-6)) * (1.0 - np.clip(leg2_energy / np.maximum(charge_rate, 1e-6) / np.maximum(horizon - d, 1e-3), 0.0, 1.0))

    cost1 = np.maximum(d + amort1, 1e-3)
    cost2 = np.maximum(T + amort2, 1e-3)
    dens1 = surv_here / cost1
    dens2 = surv2 / cost2

    # worst leg dominates: the tour is only as good as its weaker half
    tour_quality = np.where(is_item[:, None], 2.0 * dens1[:, None] * dens2 / np.maximum(dens1[:, None] + dens2, 1e-6), 0.0)
    tour_quality = np.where(is_item[None, :] & is_item[:, None] & ~np.eye(k, dtype=bool), tour_quality, 0.0)

    # best follow-up for each item: also require battery feasibility of the full two-leg trip
    back = np.linalg.norm(targets - charger[None, :], axis=1)
    feasible2 = ((d[:, None] + T + back[None, :]) * drain) <= battery
    tour_quality = np.where(feasible2, tour_quality, 0.0)

    best_follow = tour_quality.max(axis=1) if k > 0 else np.zeros(k)
    # blend the item's own standalone density with its best two-stop quality
    own = np.where(is_item, surv_here / np.maximum(d + amort1, 1e-3), 0.0)
    score_items = np.where(is_item, 0.5 * own + 0.5 * best_follow, 0.0)

    # gate: must arrive before the item dies and before the horizon ends
    alive = (surv_here > 0.0)
    score_items = np.where(is_item & alive & (d <= time_left), score_items, -0.15)

    # normalise items
    mx = np.max(np.abs(score_items)) if k > 0 else 0.0
    score_items = score_items / np.maximum(mx, 1e-6)

    # charger: pressure = reachable value at risk of vanishing that the drone cannot get to
    # before its own decay, expressed as a fraction of total reachable surviving value
    at_risk = np.where(is_item & alive, rates / np.maximum(values, 1e-6), 0.0) * surv_here
    reachable = d <= time_left
    pressure = 0.0
    if k > 0:
        denom = np.sum(np.where(is_item & reachable, surv_here, 0.0))
        pressure = float(np.sum(np.where(is_item & reachable, at_risk, 0.0)) / max(denom, 1e-6))
    pressure = min(pressure, 1.0)
    low_batt = np.clip(1.0 - battery / 0.40, 0.0, 1.0)
    stranded = 0.0 if np.any(is_item & reachable & alive) else 1.0
    charger_score = 1.6 * low_batt + 0.9 * stranded - 0.35 * pressure * (1.0 - low_batt)

    out = np.where(is_item, score_items, charger_score)
    return np.tanh(out)

import numpy as np

def feature(pos, targets, values, rates, battery, drain, charge_rate, charger, time, time_left, history):
    """Best feasible 3-stop chain (i->j->k) value-per-time rate for each item i, normalised to [0,1]."""
    k = targets.shape[0]
    is_item = values > 0
    out = np.zeros(k, dtype=float)
    idx = np.where(is_item)[0]
    n = idx.size
    if n == 0:
        return out

    P = targets[idx]            # (n,2)
    V = values[idx]             # (n,)
    R = rates[idx]              # (n,)

    # leg times from drone to each item
    d_pos = np.linalg.norm(P - pos[None, :], axis=1)          # (n,)
    # pairwise leg times between items
    diff = P[:, None, :] - P[None, :, :]                       # (n,n,2)
    d_ij = np.linalg.norm(diff, axis=2)                        # (n,n)
    # distance from each item to charger
    d_ch = np.linalg.norm(P - charger[None, :], axis=1)        # (n,)

    # single stop: i
    s_i = np.maximum(0.0, V - R * d_pos)                       # (n,)
    T1 = d_pos                                                 # (n,)
    E1 = (d_pos + d_ch) * drain
    rate1 = np.where(E1 <= battery, s_i / np.maximum(T1, 0.05), -1.0)

    # two stops: i -> j
    t2 = d_pos[:, None] + d_ij                                 # (n,n): t1_i + t2_ij
    s_j2 = np.maximum(0.0, V[None, :] - R[None, :] * t2)       # (n,n)
    V2 = s_i[:, None] + s_j2
    E2 = (t2 + d_ch[None, :]) * drain
    rate2 = np.where(E2 <= battery, V2 / np.maximum(t2, 0.05), -1.0)
    # exclude j == i
    same = np.eye(n, dtype=bool)
    rate2 = np.where(same, -1.0, rate2)

    # three stops: i -> j -> k
    t3 = t2[:, :, None] + d_ij[None, :, :]                     # (n,n,n): t1_i + t2_ij + t3_jk
    s_k3 = np.maximum(0.0, V[None, None, :] - R[None, None, :] * t3)  # (n,n,n)
    V3 = s_i[:, None, None] + s_j2[:, :, None] + s_k3
    E3 = (t3 + d_ch[None, None, :]) * drain
    rate3 = np.where(E3 <= battery, V3 / np.maximum(t3, 0.05), -1.0)
    # exclude k == j and k == i
    mask3 = same[None, :, :] | same[:, :, None]                # (n,n,n)
    rate3 = np.where(mask3, -1.0, rate3)

    best = np.maximum(rate1, np.maximum(rate2.max(axis=1), rate3.reshape(n, -1).max(axis=1)))
    best = np.maximum(best, 0.0)

    mx = best.max()
    if mx > 1e-9:
        best = best / (mx + 1e-9)
    else:
        best = np.zeros(n)

    out[idx] = best
    return out

idea.hypothesis: f065 only ever credits one follow-up, so the drone treats two items in a cluster as equally good whether or not a third is waiting behind them. import numpy as np

def feature(pos, targets, values, rates, battery, drain, charge_rate, charger, time, time_left, history):
    """Max over follow-up stops j (incl. single stop) of arrival-surviving pair value per (flight legs + forced recharge time + 0.05), normalised to [0,1]."""
    k = targets.shape[0]
    is_item = values > 0
    d = np.linalg.norm(targets - pos[None, :], axis=1)          # (k,)
    DB = np.linalg.norm(targets - charger[None, :], axis=1)     # (k,)

    # arrival-surviving value for each candidate as first stop
    s = np.maximum(0.0, values - rates * d)                     # (k,)

    # pairwise distance between candidates
    diff = targets[:, None, :] - targets[None, :, :]            # (k,k,2)
    D = np.linalg.norm(diff, axis=2)                            # (k,k)

    # second-stop arrival value: v_j - rate_j * (d_i + D[i,j])
    t2 = D                                                     # (k,k)
    s_j = np.maximum(0.0, values[None, :] - rates[None, :] * (d[:, None] + t2))  # (k,k)

    # legs and energy for pair (i,j)
    L = d[:, None] + t2                                        # (k,k)
    E = (d[:, None] + t2 + DB[None, :]) * drain                # (k,k)
    r = np.maximum(0.0, E - battery) / max(charge_rate, 1e-9)  # (k,k)

    pair_rate = (s[:, None] + s_j) / (L + r + 0.05)            # (k,k)

    # single-stop case j=i
    E_single = (d + DB) * drain
    r_single = np.maximum(0.0, E_single - battery) / max(charge_rate, 1e-9)
    single_rate = s / (d + r_single + 0.05)                    # (k,)

    # only allow j to be an item (j != i handled by single case separately)
    valid_j = is_item[None, :] & (np.arange(k)[None, :] != np.arange(k)[:, None])
    pair_rate = np.where(valid_j, pair_rate, -np.inf)

    best_pair = np.max(pair_rate, axis=1)                      # (k,)
    best_pair = np.where(np.isfinite(best_pair), best_pair, 0.0)

    feat = np.maximum(best_pair, single_rate)
    feat = np.where(is_item, feat, 0.0)

    mx = np.max(feat) if k > 0 else 0.0
    feat = feat / max(mx, 1e-9)
    feat = np.where(is_item, feat, 0.0)
    return feat

import numpy as np

def feature(pos, targets, values, rates, battery, drain, charge_rate, charger, time, time_left, history):
    """Best-pair tour value per time (V/(L+0.05)) times tanh(3*(range-E)/range) smooth battery-range margin, normalised to ~[-1,1]; charger 0."""
    k = targets.shape[0]
    is_item = values > 0
    out = np.zeros(k, dtype=float)
    if not np.any(is_item):
        return out

    d = np.sqrt(np.maximum(((targets - pos) ** 2).sum(axis=1), 0.0))  # (k,)
    D = np.sqrt(np.maximum(((targets[:, None, :] - targets[None, :, :]) ** 2).sum(axis=2), 0.0))  # (k,k)
    DB = np.sqrt(np.maximum(((targets - charger) ** 2).sum(axis=1), 0.0))  # (k,)

    v = values
    r = rates
    L = d[:, None] + D  # (k,k) time to reach i then j
    Vi = np.maximum(0.0, v - r * d)  # (k,) value of i at arrival
    Vj = np.maximum(0.0, v[None, :] - r[None, :] * L)  # (k,k) value of j at arrival
    V = Vi[:, None] + Vj  # (k,k)
    base = V / (L + 0.05)  # (k,k)

    E = (d[:, None] + D + DB[None, :]) * drain  # (k,k)
    rng = battery / max(drain, 1e-9)
    margin = (rng - E) / max(rng, 1e-6)
    gate = np.tanh(3.0 * margin)

    score = base * gate  # (k,k)
    # only item rows as i and item columns as j
    score = np.where(is_item[:, None] & is_item[None, :], score, -np.inf)
    best = np.max(score, axis=1)  # (k,)
    best = np.where(is_item, best, 0.0)

    scale = np.max(np.abs(best[is_item])) if np.any(is_item) else 0.0
    scale = max(scale, 1e-9)
    out = best / scale
    out = np.where(is_item, out, 0.0)
    return np.nan_to_num(out, nan=0.0, posinf=0.0, neginf=0.0)

import numpy as np

def feature(pos, targets, values, rates, battery, drain, charge_rate, charger, time, time_left, history):
    """Signed score that ranks each item by its value density but discounts it by the value of the best alternative foregone per unit of the same resource (time vs energy), so relative opportunity cost, not absolute rate, drives the choice; charger gets its own deferral/stranding pull."""
    d = np.linalg.norm(targets - pos[None, :], axis=1)
    is_item = values > 0

    d_back = np.linalg.norm(charger[None, :] - targets, axis=1)
    need = (d + d_back) * drain
    feasible = (need <= battery) | (~is_item)

    # time cost of the trip incl. forced recharge for outbound energy
    recharge_time = (d * drain) / np.maximum(charge_rate, 1e-3)
    trip_time = np.maximum(d + recharge_time, 1e-3)
    energy_use = np.maximum(d * drain, 1e-3)

    projected = np.maximum(values - rates * d, 0.0)
    survival = np.where(is_item, projected / np.maximum(values, 1e-6), 0.0)
    arrives_before_end = d <= time_left
    ok = is_item & feasible & arrives_before_end

    # raw densities
    dens_t = np.where(is_item, projected / trip_time, 0.0)       # value per time
    dens_e = np.where(is_item, projected / energy_use, 0.0)      # value per energy

    best_t = np.max(dens_t) if np.any(is_item) else 0.0
    best_e = np.max(dens_e) if np.any(is_item) else 0.0

    # opportunity cost: how much better the best alternative is on the SAME resource
    # ratio in [0,1]: 1 = this item is the best on that resource, small = dominated
    edge_t = np.where(is_item, dens_t / np.maximum(best_t, 1e-6), 0.0)
    edge_e = np.where(is_item, dens_e / np.maximum(best_e, 1e-6), 0.0)
    # geometric mean: strong only if good on both, punishes one-dim wonders
    edge = np.sqrt(np.clip(edge_t, 0.0, 1.0) * np.clip(edge_e, 0.0, 1.0))

    # combine density with survival, edge and feasibility
    combined = np.log1p(0.5 * (dens_t + dens_e)) * survival * edge
    item_score = np.where(ok, combined, -0.5 * (1.0 - survival) * is_item)

    # charger pull
    batt_at_charger = battery - d * drain
    low_batt = np.clip(1.0 - batt_at_charger / 0.35, 0.0, 1.0)
    any_ok = np.any(ok)
    stranded = 0.0 if any_ok else 1.0
    defer = -0.6 * (1.0 - low_batt) * (1.0 if any_ok else 0.0)
    charger_score = 2.0 * low_batt + 1.2 * stranded + defer

    score = np.where(is_item, item_score, charger_score)
    return np.tanh(score)

    is_item = values > 0

    D = np.linalg.norm(diff, axis=2)

    # first stop arrival value

    s_j = np.maximum(0.0, values[None, :] - rates[None, :] * t2)

    # soft expiry: follow-up survival fraction (0 if it dies before arrival)

import numpy as np

def feature(pos, targets, values, rates, battery, drain, charge_rate, charger, time, time_left, history):
    """Charger row: signed recharge timing pressure — how much future value density (from history appearance rate x mean value density) will pass while recharging, minus the value the visible items at risk will decay during that same recharge; positive = charge now, negative = defer; items get the mirror-image decay-during-recharge penalty so the charger and the best item compete directly."""
    k = len(values)
    is_item = values > 0
    out = np.zeros(k, dtype=float)

    # --- recharge duration from current deficit ---
    deficit = np.clip(1.0 - battery, 0.0, 1.0)
    recharge_t = deficit / max(charge_rate, 1e-3)

    # --- estimate future value-pool density from history ---
    if history.shape[0] >= 3:
        t_app = history[:, 2]
        span = max(time - t_app.min(), 1e-3)
        appear_rate = history.shape[0] / span
        v0 = history[:, 3]
        rr = np.maximum(history[:, 4], 1e-6)
        dens = v0 * rr  # peak value bleed per time
        mean_dens = float(np.mean(np.clip(dens, 0.0, None)))
    else:
        appear_rate = 1.0
        mean_dens = 1.0

    future_pool = np.log1p(appear_rate * mean_dens * recharge_t)
    # only valuable if there is time to exploit the future items after recharging
    horizon_ok = np.clip(time_left / max(recharge_t + 1.0, 1e-3), 0.0, 1.0)

    # --- value currently visible items would lose during that recharge ---
    item_vals = np.where(is_item, values, 0.0)
    item_rates = np.where(is_item, rates, 0.0)
    visible_decay = np.minimum(item_rates * recharge_t, item_vals)
    total_visible_decay = float(np.sum(visible_decay))
    total_visible_value = float(np.sum(item_vals))
    decay_frac = total_visible_decay / max(total_visible_value, 1e-3)

    # charger signal: charge now if the future pool beats the decay we'd let happen
    charger_raw = future_pool * horizon_ok - 2.0 * decay_frac
    out[~is_item] = np.tanh(charger_raw)

    # items get the mirror: an item's own decay during a hypothetical recharge
    if np.any(is_item):
        own_decay_frac = visible_decay / np.maximum(item_vals, 1e-6)  # per item in [0,1]
        item_score = np.tanh(0.5 * (1.0 - own_decay_frac) - 0.5 * future_pool * horizon_ok)
        out = np.where(is_item, item_score, out)
    return out

import numpy as np

def feature(pos, targets, values, rates, battery, drain, charge_rate, charger, time, time_left, history):
    """Per item: arrival-surviving value divided by the *net* time cost of detouring to it relative to heading straight back to the charger, i.e. isolates the marginal benefit of the detour over the baseline recharge trip; charger gets a small negative or strong positive depending on battery."""
    d = np.linalg.norm(targets - pos[None, :], axis=1)
    d_home = np.linalg.norm(pos - charger)
    d_back = np.linalg.norm(targets - charger[None, :], axis=1)
    is_item = values > 0

    # baseline trip: fly straight home and recharge the energy we will use
    energy_home = d_home * drain
    recharge_home = energy_home / np.maximum(charge_rate, 1e-3)
    baseline_time = d_home + recharge_home

    # detour trip: fly to item then home, recharge all energy spent
    energy_trip = (d + d_back) * drain
    recharge_trip = energy_trip / np.maximum(charge_rate, 1e-3)
    trip_time = d + d_back + recharge_trip

    # marginal time the detour costs over just going home
    extra_time = np.maximum(trip_time - baseline_time, 1e-3)

    # projected value at arrival
    projected = np.maximum(values - rates * d, 0.0)

    # marginal value per marginal time
    marg = np.where(is_item, projected / extra_time, 0.0)

    # hard feasibility: full round trip must fit in current battery
    feasible = ((d + d_back) * drain <= battery) | (~is_item)
    arrives_before_end = d <= time_left
    ok = is_item & feasible & arrives_before_end

    # log-squash and normalise by max positive marginal to keep in [-1,1]
    sq = np.log1p(np.maximum(marg, 0.0))
    mx = np.max(np.where(ok, sq, 0.0)) if np.any(ok) else 0.0
    mx = max(mx, 1e-6)
    item_score = np.where(ok, sq / mx, np.where(is_item, -0.2, 0.0))

    # charger: pull proportional to how little battery remains after going home
    batt_home = battery - energy_home
    low = np.clip(1.0 - batt_home / 0.4, 0.0, 1.0)
    stranded = 0.0 if np.any(ok) else 1.0
    charger_score = 1.5 * low + 1.0 * stranded - 0.4 * (1.0 - low) * (0.0 if stranded else 1.0)

    score = np.where(is_item, item_score, charger_score)
    return np.tanh(score)

    recharge_later = out_energy / np.maximum(charge_rate, 1e-3)
    busy = np.maximum(d + recharge_later, 1e-3)

    projected = np.maximum(values - rates * d, 0.0)

    n_items = float(np.sum(is_item))
    if n_items > 0:
        decay_pressure = float(np.mean(np.where(is_item, rates, 0.0)))
        mean_val = float(np.sum(values) / n_items)
    else:
        decay_pressure = 0.0
        mean_val = 0.0
    opportunity_loss = decay_pressure * busy * mean_val

    net = projected - opportunity_loss

    arrives = d <= time_left
    pos_net = np.where(is_item & feasible & arrives, net, 0.0)
    scale = float(np.max(np.abs(pos_net))) if np.any(is_item) else 0.0
    scale = max(scale, 1e-6)

    item_score = np.where(is_item & feasible & arrives, net / scale,
                          -0.4 * (1.0 - projected / np.maximum(values, 1e-6)) - 0.1)
    item_score = np.clip(item_score, -1.0, 1.0)

    batt_after = battery - d * drain
    low = np.clip(1.0 - batt_after / 0.25, 0.0, 1.0)
    any_ok = bool(np.any(is_item & feasible & arrives))
    stranded = 0.0 if any_ok else 1.0
    charger_score = min(1.5 * stranded + 1.0 * low, 1.0)

    score = np.where(is_item, item_score, charger_score)
    return np.nan_to_num(score, nan=0.0, posinf=0.0, neginf=0.0)

import numpy as np

def feature(pos, targets, values, rates, battery, drain, charge_rate, charger, time, time_left, history):
    """Best two-stop tour value-per-time with a post-stop reserve gate (nearest other item as a real leg), normalised to [-1, 1]; charger row 0."""
    k = targets.shape[0]
    is_item = values > 0
    # distances from drone to each candidate
    d = np.linalg.norm(targets - pos[None, :], axis=1)  # (k,)
    # pairwise distances between candidates
    diff = targets[:, None, :] - targets[None, :, :]  # (k,k,2)
    D = np.linalg.norm(diff, axis=2)  # (k,k)
    # survival of item i at arrival time d_i
    safe_vi = np.where(is_item, values, 1.0)
    s_i = values * np.clip(1.0 - rates * d / safe_vi, 0.0, 1.0)  # (k,)
    # survival of follow-up j at time d_i + D_ij
    t_ij = d[:, None] + D  # (k,k)
    safe_vj = np.where(is_item, values, 1.0)[None, :]
    s_j = values[None, :] * np.clip(1.0 - rates[None, :] * t_ij / safe_vj, 0.0, 1.0)  # (k,k)
    # charger follow-up contributes 0 value
    s_j = np.where(is_item[None, :], s_j, 0.0)
    V = s_i[:, None] + s_j  # (k,k)
    L = d[:, None] + D  # (k,k)
    # energy: d_i + D_ij + dist(targets_j, charger)
    dist_j_charger = np.linalg.norm(targets - charger[None, :], axis=1)  # (k,)
    E = (d[:, None] + D + dist_j_charger[None, :]) * drain  # (k,k)
    # R_j: distance from targets_j to nearest visible item other than i and j
    # For each j, nearest other item distance (excluding j itself); then exclude i too.
    # Compute nearest-other-item distance for each j over all items.
    item_mask = is_item
    # distances among items
    D_items = D  # (k,k)
    big = 1e9
    # nearest other item to j (excluding j)
    Dm = np.where(item_mask[None, :] & item_mask[:, None], D_items, big)
    np.fill_diagonal(Dm, big)
    nearest_other = Dm.min(axis=0)  # (k,) nearest item to j other than j
    # Now for pair (i,j), R_j should exclude i as well. If i is the nearest, use second nearest.
    # Build second-nearest by masking i per row.
    # R_ij = min over items m != i, m != j of D[j,m]
    # Vectorised: for each i, mask out i in Dm, take min over m.
    # Dm shape (k,k) indexed [m, j]? We built Dm as [m,j] with mask item_mask[m]&item_mask[j].
    # Actually Dm[a,b] = D[a,b] if both items else big. min over axis=0 gives nearest item to j.
    # For excluding i: set Dm[i, :] = big then min over axis 0.
    # Do it as (k_i, k_j) result: R[i,j] = min_m Dm_excl_i[m,j]
    # Efficient: compute two smallest along axis 0 for each j.
    Dm_sorted = np.sort(Dm, axis=0)  # (k,k) sorted along m for each j
    nearest1 = Dm_sorted[0, :]  # (k,)
    nearest2 = Dm_sorted[1, :]  # (k,)
    # argmin index along axis 0
    argmin_m = np.argmin(Dm, axis=0)  # (k,) index m that is nearest to j
    # R[i,j] = nearest1[j] if argmin_m[j] != i else nearest2[j]
    R = np.where(argmin_m[None, :] == np.arange(k)[:, None], nearest2[None, :], nearest1[None, :])  # (k,k)
    R = np.where(R >= big, 0.0, R)
    # charger follow-up: R = 0
    R = np.where(is_item[None, :], R, 0.0)
    # gate
    denom = np.maximum(battery, 0.05)
    margin_item = battery - E - drain * R
    margin_charger = battery - E
    g = np.where(is_item[None, :], np.tanh(3.0 * margin_item / denom), np.tanh(3.0 * margin_charger / denom))
    r = (V / (L + 0.05)) * g  # (k,k)
    # j* = argmax over j for each i
    r_best = r.max(axis=1)  # (k,)
    # charger row is 0
    r_best = np.where(is_item, r_best, 0.0)
    mx = np.max(np.abs(r_best))
    if mx <= 0 or not np.isfinite(mx):
        return np.zeros(k)
    out = r_best / mx
    return np.where(np.isfinite(out), out, 0.0)

import numpy as np

def feature(pos, targets, values, rates, battery, drain, charge_rate, charger, time, time_left, history):
    """Best gated three-stop chain rate: max over follow-up pairs (j,k) of chain value per chain length times a tanh battery-range margin, normalised by the max over candidates; charger 0."""
    k = targets.shape[0]
    is_item = values > 0
    d = np.linalg.norm(targets - pos[None, :], axis=1)  # (k,)

    # single-trip surviving value at arrival
    def surv(idx, t):
        v = values[idx]
        r = rates[idx]
        return v * np.clip(1.0 - r * t / np.maximum(v, 1e-12), 0.0, 1.0)

    s_self = surv(np.arange(k), d)  # (k,)

    # pool: up to 8 items with highest single-trip density, plus charger row
    density = s_self / (d + 0.05)
    item_idx = np.where(is_item)[0]
    charger_idx = np.where(~is_item)[0]
    if item_idx.size > 8:
        top = item_idx[np.argsort(-density[item_idx])[:8]]
    else:
        top = item_idx
    pool = np.concatenate([top, charger_idx[:1]]) if charger_idx.size > 0 else top
    m = pool.shape[0]

    P = targets[pool]           # (m,2)
    Vp = values[pool]           # (m,)
    Rp = rates[pool]            # (m,)
    D = np.linalg.norm(P[:, None, :] - P[None, :, :], axis=2)  # (m,m)

    # for each candidate i: d_i, s_i(d_i)
    di = d[:, None, None]                     # (k,1,1)
    si = s_self[:, None, None]                # (k,1,1)

    # D_ij: (k,m)
    Dij = np.linalg.norm(targets[:, None, :] - P[None, :, :], axis=2)  # (k,m)
    t_j = d[:, None] + Dij                    # (k,m) arrival time at j
    s_j = Vp[None, :] * np.clip(1.0 - Rp[None, :] * t_j / np.maximum(Vp[None, :], 1e-12), 0.0, 1.0)  # (k,m)

    # D_jk: (m,m) -> (k,m,m)
    Djk = D[None, :, :]                       # (1,m,m)
    t_k = t_j[:, :, None] + Djk               # (k,m,m)
    s_k = Vp[None, None, :] * np.clip(1.0 - Rp[None, None, :] * t_k / np.maximum(Vp[None, None, :], 1e-12), 0.0, 1.0)  # (k,m,m)

    V = si + s_j[:, :, None] + s_k            # (k,m,m)
    L = d[:, None, None] + Dij[:, :, None] + Djk  # (k,m,m)
    E = L * drain
    gate = np.tanh(3.0 * (battery - E) / max(battery, 0.05))  # (k,m,m)

    rate = (V / (L + 0.05)) * gate            # (k,m,m)
    best = rate.reshape(k, -1).max(axis=1)    # (k,)

    best = np.where(is_item, best, 0.0)
    mx = best.max() if best.size > 0 else 0.0
    if mx <= 0:
        return np.zeros(k)
    return best / mx

import numpy as np

def feature(pos, targets, values, rates, battery, drain, charge_rate, charger, time, time_left, history):
    """Arrival value of each item minus the value a budgeted greedy selection loses when it is inserted, normalised by total selected value."""
    k = targets.shape[0]
    is_item = values > 0
    d = np.linalg.norm(targets - pos[None, :], axis=1)
    # arrival-surviving value at time d
    s = values * np.clip(1.0 - rates * d / np.maximum(values, 1e-12), 0.0, 1.0)
    s = np.where(is_item, s, 0.0)
    rho = np.where(is_item, s / (d + 0.05), -np.inf)
    order = np.argsort(-rho)
    dd = (d + 0.05)[order]
    ss = s[order]
    cum = np.cumsum(dd)
    cumv = np.cumsum(ss)
    total = max(cumv[-1], 1e-6) if cumv.size > 0 else 1e-6
    B = min(time_left, battery / max(drain, 1e-6))

    def F(x):
        x = np.asarray(x, dtype=float)
        idx = np.searchsorted(cum, x, side='right') - 1
        out = np.where(idx >= 0, cumv[np.clip(idx, 0, cumv.size - 1)], 0.0)
        return out

    FB = F(np.array([B]))[0]
    x2 = np.maximum(B - 2.0 * d, 0.0)
    F2 = F(x2)
    feat = (s - (FB - F2)) / total
    feat = np.clip(feat, -1.0, 1.0)
    feat = np.where(is_item, feat, 0.0)
    return feat

import numpy as np

def feature(pos, targets, values, rates, battery, drain, charge_rate, charger, time, time_left, history):
    """Charger row: tanh(3*(predicted next-burst time - time to reach+charge)/burst period), items 0."""
    k = targets.shape[0]
    out = np.zeros(k, dtype=float)
    charger_mask = (values == 0)
    if not np.any(charger_mask):
        return out
    if history.shape[0] < 6:
        return out
    t_app = history[:, 2]
    gaps = np.diff(t_app)
    if gaps.size == 0:
        return out
    recent = gaps[-12:]
    thr = 1.5 * np.median(recent)
    if not (thr > 0):
        return out
    # burst starts: t_app[i+1] for every gap > thr
    burst_starts = t_app[1:][gaps > thr]
    if burst_starts.size < 2:
        return out
    P = float(np.median(np.diff(burst_starts)))
    if not (P > 0.1):
        return out
    last = float(np.max(burst_starts))
    t_next = max(last + P - time, 0.0)
    dist = float(np.linalg.norm(pos - charger))
    commit = dist + (1.0 - battery) / max(charge_rate, 1e-6)
    score = float(np.tanh(3.0 * (t_next - commit) / P))
    out[charger_mask] = score
    return out

import numpy as np

def feature(pos, targets, values, rates, battery, drain, charge_rate, charger, time, time_left, history):
    """Signed urgency score where an item's value rate is discounted by the opportunity cost of the *time window* it occupies: the projected value per unit time is multiplied by the fraction of the remaining horizon it leaves free (horizon-fraction), so items that would monopolise the last stretch of the run are penalised; charger gets a signed deferral/stranding score."""
    d = np.linalg.norm(targets - pos[None, :], axis=1)
    is_item = values > 0

    d_charger = np.linalg.norm(charger[None, :] - targets, axis=1)
    need = (d + d_charger) * drain
    feasible = (need <= battery) | (~is_item)

    # outbound time + forced recharge for energy spent
    recharge_time = (d * drain) / np.maximum(charge_rate, 1e-3)
    trip_time = np.maximum(d + recharge_time, 1e-3)

    projected = np.maximum(values - rates * d, 0.0)
    survival = np.where(is_item, projected / np.maximum(values, 1e-6), 0.0)

    arrives_before_end = d <= time_left

    # base rate: survival-weighted projected value per unit trip time
    rate_surv = np.where(is_item, projected / trip_time, 0.0)

    # horizon-fraction: how much of the remaining horizon this trip consumes.
    # items that eat a big share of the remaining time get discounted,
    # because the horizon is a shared resource for all future items.
    horizon = np.maximum(time_left, 1e-6)
    occupy = np.clip(trip_time / horizon, 0.0, 1.0)
    horizon_factor = 1.0 - occupy            # 1 = instant/free, 0 = eats the whole run

    # competition: edge of this item's rate over the best competing rate
    best_compet = np.max(rate_surv) if np.any(is_item) else 0.0
    edge = np.where(is_item, np.clip(rate_surv / np.maximum(best_compet, 1e-6), 0.0, 1.0), 0.0)

    # log-squash the rate so big values don't swamp, then weight by survival,
    # horizon-freedom and competition edge, and gate by feasibility/time.
    item_score = np.log1p(rate_surv) * survival * horizon_factor * (0.25 + 0.75 * edge)
    item_score = np.where(is_item, item_score, 0.0)
    bad = is_item & ((~feasible) | (~arrives_before_end))
    item_score = np.where(bad, -0.5 * (1.0 - survival) - 0.1, item_score)

    # charger: strong pull when battery low after the trip, defer otherwise
    batt_at_charger = battery - d * drain
    low_batt = np.clip(1.0 - batt_at_charger / 0.35, 0.0, 1.0)
    any_feasible = np.any(is_item & feasible & arrives_before_end)
    stranded = 0.0 if any_feasible else 1.0
    defer = -0.6 * (1.0 - low_batt) * (1.0 if any_feasible else 0.0)
    charger_score = 2.0 * low_batt + 1.2 * stranded + defer

    score = np.where(is_item, item_score, charger_score)
    return np.tanh(score)

import numpy as np

def feature(pos, targets, values, rates, battery, drain, charge_rate, charger, time, time_left, history):
    """Per item: best-pair tour rate where the pair value is discounted by each leg's own survival against its item lifetime (multiplicative decay per leg), the time budget adds forced recharge for the whole tour, and the battery margin is gated smoothly; charger 0."""
    k = targets.shape[0]
    is_item = values > 0
    out = np.zeros(k, dtype=float)
    if not np.any(is_item):
        return out

    d = np.sqrt(np.maximum(((targets - pos) ** 2).sum(axis=1), 0.0))            # (k,) now -> i
    D = np.sqrt(np.maximum(((targets[:, None, :] - targets[None, :, :]) ** 2).sum(axis=2), 0.0))  # (k,k) i -> j
    DB = np.sqrt(np.maximum(((targets - charger) ** 2).sum(axis=1), 0.0))        # (k,) j -> charger

    v = values
    r = rates
    life = v / np.maximum(r, 1e-9)                                              # (k,) remaining lifetime
    L = d[:, None] + D                                                          # (k,k) time now -> i -> j

    # per-leg survival discount: leg time relative to each item's own lifetime
    leg_i = d[:, None] / np.maximum(life[:, None], 1e-9)                        # (k,1)
    leg_j = D / np.maximum(life[None, :], 1e-9)                                 # (k,k)
    surv_i = np.exp(-np.clip(leg_i, 0.0, 50.0))                                 # (k,1)
    surv_j = np.exp(-np.clip(leg_j, 0.0, 50.0))                                 # (k,k)

    # value collected at each stop (arrival value, not decayed to zero)
    Vi = np.maximum(0.0, v - r * d)                                             # (k,)
    Vj = np.maximum(0.0, v[None, :] - r[None, :] * L)                           # (k,k)
    V = Vi[:, None] * surv_i + Vj * surv_j                                      # decay-weighted pair value

    # tour time: legs + forced recharge for energy spent over the whole tour
    energy = (d[:, None] + D) * drain
    recharge = energy / np.maximum(charge_rate, 1e-3)
    T = np.maximum(L + recharge + 0.05, 1e-3)

    base = V / T                                                                # (k,k) value per time

    # smooth battery margin over the whole tour incl. return to charger
    E = (d[:, None] + D + DB[None, :]) * drain
    rng = battery / max(drain, 1e-9)
    margin = (rng - E) / max(rng, 1e-6)
    gate = np.tanh(3.0 * margin)

    score = base * gate
    score = np.where(is_item[:, None] & is_item[None, :], score, -np.inf)
    best = np.max(score, axis=1)
    best = np.where(is_item, best, 0.0)

    scale = np.max(np.abs(best[is_item])) if np.any(is_item) else 0.0
    scale = max(scale, 1e-9)
    out = best / scale
    out = np.where(is_item, out, 0.0)
    return np.nan_to_num(out, nan=0.0, posinf=0.0, neginf=0.0)

import numpy as np

def feature(pos, targets, values, rates, battery, drain, charge_rate, charger, time, time_left, history):
    """Endgame 'no-return' opportunity: for each item, arrival value per outbound time is amplified when the trip cannot be repaid before the end (time_left < outbound + return + recharge), scaled by how deeply the deadline is violated; charger gets a negative mirror so it is preferred only when an item is not worth the one-way gamble."""
    d = np.linalg.norm(targets - pos[None, :], axis=1)              # outbound time
    is_item = values > 0

    d_back = np.linalg.norm(charger[None, :] - targets, axis=1)     # return leg to charger
    recharge_t = np.maximum(1.0 - battery, 0.0) / np.maximum(charge_rate, 1e-6)
    round_trip = d + d_back + recharge_t                            # time to fetch and be back full

    # how much of the remaining horizon is consumed by the round trip
    # deep violation (round_trip >> time_left) -> strong one-way signal; slack -> 0
    violation = np.clip((round_trip - time_left) / np.maximum(round_trip, 1e-6), 0.0, 1.0)

    # arrival value per outbound time, squashed
    v_arr = np.maximum(values - rates * d, 0.0)
    density = np.log1p(v_arr / (d + 0.05))

    # endgame boost: items whose round trip overruns the clock get a value-per-time push,
    # but only if the item itself still survives the (one-way) flight and arrives in time
    survives = (v_arr > 0) & (d <= time_left)
    item_score = np.where(is_item & survives, density * (0.2 + 0.8 * violation), 0.0)

    # items that die mid-flight or miss the end are pushed negative in proportion to loss
    lost = 1.0 - np.where(values > 0, v_arr / np.maximum(values, 1e-6), 0.0)
    dead = is_item & ((v_arr <= 0) | (d > time_left))
    item_score = np.where(dead, -0.5 * lost - 0.1, item_score)

    # charger: negative when a worthwhile one-way item exists (defer the recharge),
    # positive when nothing survives and the clock is nearly out
    any_gamble = np.any(is_item & survives & (violation > 0.5))
    charger_score = np.where(any_gamble, -0.7, 0.0) + 0.8 * np.clip(1.0 - time_left, 0.0, 1.0)

    score = np.where(is_item, item_score, charger_score)
    return np.tanh(score)

import numpy as np

def feature(pos, targets, values, rates, battery, drain, charge_rate, charger, time, time_left, history):
    """Density of nearby item value around each candidate: how much total value sits within a shrinking neighbourhood of the candidate, discounted by decay-rate (how fast that neighbourhood will rot), normalised to [-1,1]; charger gets its own pull term."""
    k = targets.shape[0]
    is_item = values > 0
    out = np.zeros(k, dtype=float)
    if k == 0:
        return out

    # pairwise distances
    diff = targets[:, None, :] - targets[None, :, :]
    D = np.sqrt(np.maximum((diff ** 2).sum(axis=2), 0.0))  # (k,k)

    d_self = np.sqrt(np.maximum(((targets - pos) ** 2).sum(axis=1), 0.0))  # (k,)

    # neighbourhood radius grows with the candidate's own reachability time (a "sweep" around it)
    # use a per-candidate scale: 0.15 area units + travel time to reach it
    radius = 0.15 + d_self  # (k,)
    R = radius[:, None]  # (k,1)

    # kernel: gaussian bump, only over items
    w = np.exp(-((D / np.maximum(R, 1e-6)) ** 2))
    w = np.where(is_item[None, :], w, 0.0)
    np.fill_diagonal(w, 0.0)  # exclude self

    # local value mass, weighted by each neighbour's decay pressure (fast-decaying neighbours count less because they rot soon)
    # decay pressure: fraction of neighbour value lost in the time it takes to sweep to it
    decay_frac = np.clip(D * rates[None, :] / np.maximum(values[None, :], 1e-6), 0.0, 1.0)
    surv = 1.0 - decay_frac  # (k,k)
    contrib = w * values[None, :] * surv

    mass = contrib.sum(axis=1)  # (k,)

    # normalise: divide by total visible value (a density-like share), squash
    total_val = float(np.sum(values[is_item])) if np.any(is_item) else 0.0
    share = mass / max(total_val, 1e-6)
    item_score = np.tanh(2.5 * share)  # 0..~1
    item_score = np.where(is_item, item_score, 0.0)

    # charger: pull when battery is low relative to what a sweep would need, or when nothing reachable
    d_charger = np.sqrt(np.maximum(((charger - pos) ** 2).sum(), 0.0))
    batt_at_charger = battery - d_charger * drain
    low = np.clip(1.0 - batt_at_charger / 0.35, 0.0, 1.0)
    any_item = bool(np.any(is_item))
    stranded = 0.0 if any_item else 1.0
    charger_score = np.tanh(1.5 * low + 1.0 * stranded)

    out = np.where(is_item, item_score, charger_score)
    return np.nan_to_num(out, nan=0.0, posinf=1.0, neginf=-1.0)
features.measures: Density of nearby item value around each candidate: how much total value sits within a shrinking neighbourhood of the candidate, discounted by decay-rate (how fast that neighbourhood will rot), normalised to [-1,1]; charger gets its own pull term.

import numpy as np

def feature(pos, targets, values, rates, battery, drain, charge_rate, charger, time, time_left, history):
    """Time-to-death race: for each item, the slack between its remaining lifetime and the trip time needed to reach it, expressed as a smooth saturating ratio (positive = can make it with room, negative = will vanish en route); charger scored by how many items are currently in the 'about to be lost' band, so the charger becomes attractive when several items are slipping away."""
    d = np.linalg.norm(targets - pos[None, :], axis=1)
    is_item = values > 0

    # remaining lifetime of each item (time until value hits 0)
    lifetime = np.where(is_item, values / np.maximum(rates, 1e-6), 0.0)

    # time to reach the candidate (speed 1) plus, for items, a recharge overhead proportional
    # to the energy spent relative to the current battery (a proxy for the detour cost later)
    energy_out = d * drain
    recharge_overhead = energy_out / np.maximum(charge_rate, 1e-3)
    trip_time = d + recharge_overhead

    # slack in time units: how much lifetime is left after the trip
    slack = np.where(is_item, lifetime - trip_time, 0.0)
    # normalise by the item's own lifetime so fast decayers are judged on their own clock
    slack_ratio = np.where(is_item, slack / np.maximum(lifetime, 1e-6), 0.0)
    race = np.tanh(2.0 * slack_ratio)  # in (-1, 1): >0 survive with margin, <0 doomed

    # value still collectible at arrival (for weighting: doomed items matter less)
    projected = np.where(is_item, np.maximum(values - rates * d, 0.0), 0.0)
    value_share = np.where(is_item, projected / np.maximum(values, 1e-6), 0.0)

    # items that are borderline (about to be lost if not taken soon): slack small and positive
    borderline = np.where(is_item, np.exp(-np.clip(np.abs(slack) / np.maximum(lifetime, 1e-6), 0.0, 50.0) * 4.0), 0.0)
    lost_value_now = np.sum(projected * borderline)

    # charger: pull grows with the total borderline value at risk and shrinks with battery health
    batt_after = battery - d * drain
    low_batt = np.clip(1.0 - batt_after / 0.35, 0.0, 1.0)
    risk = np.tanh(lost_value_now / np.maximum(np.sum(projected) + 1e-6, 1e-6))
    any_reachable = np.any(is_item & (projected > 0) & (d <= time_left))
    stranded = 0.0 if any_reachable else 1.0
    charger_score = 1.5 * low_batt + 1.0 * stranded + 0.5 * risk

    # item score: prefer items we can still win, weighted by value share, penalise doomed ones
    item_score = race * (0.3 + 0.7 * value_share)
    item_score = np.where(is_item & (d > time_left), -0.5, item_score)

    score = np.where(is_item, item_score, charger_score)
    return np.tanh(score)
features.measures: Time-to-death race: for each item, the slack between its remaining lifetime and the trip time needed to reach it, expressed as a smooth saturating ratio (positive = can make it with room, negative = will vanish en route); charger scored by how many items are currently in the 'about to be lost' band, so the charger becomes attractive when several items are slipping away.

import numpy as np

def feature(pos, targets, values, rates, battery, drain, charge_rate, charger, time, time_left, history):
    """For each item i: value it contributes specifically as the SECOND stop of a tour from some other item j (i.e. best partner j's arrival-surviving value discounted by i's own decay during the detour), per unit of extra detour time, gated by a smooth battery margin; charger 0. Measures marginal value of i as a follow-up target, not as a lead."""
    k = targets.shape[0]
    is_item = values > 0
    out = np.zeros(k, dtype=float)
    if not np.any(is_item):
        return out

    d = np.sqrt(np.maximum(((targets - pos) ** 2).sum(axis=1), 0.0))          # (k,)
    D = np.sqrt(np.maximum(((targets[:, None, :] - targets[None, :, :]) ** 2).sum(axis=2), 0.0))  # (k,k)
    DB = np.sqrt(np.maximum(((targets - charger) ** 2).sum(axis=1), 0.0))     # (k,)

    v = values
    r = np.maximum(rates, 1e-9)

    # Tour j -> i: arrive at j at time d_j, then fly D[j,i] to i.
    # Value collected at i is v_i - r_i * (d_j + D[j,i]).
    L = d[:, None] + D                       # (k,k) time from now to item j then i
    Vi = np.maximum(0.0, v[None, :] - r[None, :] * L)   # (k,k) surviving value of i (column) after tour via j (row)
    Vj = np.maximum(0.0, v - r * d)          # (k,) surviving value of lead j

    # Marginal value of i given the tour: i's surviving value only (the part attributable to i as second stop),
    # relative to the extra detour time D[j,i] beyond the direct trip to j.
    detour = D + 1e-3
    marginal = Vi / detour                   # (k,k)

    # feasibility of the j->i leg plus return to charger
    E = (d[:, None] + D + DB[None, :]) * drain
    rng = battery / max(drain, 1e-9)
    margin = (rng - E) / max(rng, 1e-6)
    gate = np.tanh(3.0 * margin)             # (k,k)

    # also require the lead j to itself survive enough to be a plausible partner
    lead_ok = (Vj > 0).astype(float)         # (k,)
    chain = marginal * gate * lead_ok[:, None]

    # For each column i (the follow-up candidate), take the BEST partner j
    score = np.where(is_item[None, :], chain, -np.inf)   # rows j, cols i
    # exclude self-pairing
    score = np.where(np.eye(k, dtype=bool), -np.inf, score)
    best = np.max(score, axis=0)             # (k,) per candidate i
    best = np.where(np.isfinite(best), best, 0.0)
    best = np.where(is_item, best, 0.0)

    scale = np.max(np.abs(best[is_item])) if np.any(is_item) else 0.0
    scale = max(scale, 1e-9)
    out = best / scale
    return np.nan_to_num(out, nan=0.0, posinf=0.0, neginf=0.0)

import numpy as np

def feature(pos, targets, values, rates, battery, drain, charge_rate, charger, time, time_left, history):
    """Arrival-surviving value per (trip distance + recharge time forced by the reserve needed for the nearest other visible item), normalised to [-1, 1]; charger 0."""

    is_item = values > 0

    # Distance from drone to each candidate.
    d = np.linalg.norm(targets - pos[None, :], axis=1)

    # Value surviving the flight to the candidate.
    v_arr = np.maximum(values - rates * d, 0.0)

    # Pairwise distances between candidates.

    D = np.linalg.norm(diff, axis=2)

import numpy as np

def feature(pos, targets, values, rates, battery, drain, charge_rate, charger, time, time_left, history):
    """Net value-per-time urgency: arrival-surviving value divided by (travel + recharge overhead) minus the same quantity for the best competing item, so the score is a marginal edge over the field rather than an absolute rate; the charger gets a signed reserve/stranding score."""
    d = np.linalg.norm(targets - pos[None, :], axis=1)
    is_item = values > 0

    d_back = np.linalg.norm(charger[None, :] - targets, axis=1)
    need = (d + d_back) * drain
    feasible = (need <= battery) | (~is_item)
    arrives_before_end = d <= time_left

    recharge_time = (d * drain) / np.maximum(charge_rate, 1e-3)
    trip_time = np.maximum(d + recharge_time, 1e-3)

    projected = np.maximum(values - rates * d, 0.0)
    survival = np.where(is_item, projected / np.maximum(values, 1e-6), 0.0)

    # absolute value rate per item
    rate_v = np.where(is_item, projected / trip_time, 0.0)

    # ranking against the field: second-best competitor's rate is the reference,
    # so the leader keeps its full edge but ties collapse to ~0
    masked = np.where(is_item, rate_v, -np.inf)
    best = np.max(masked) if np.any(is_item) else 0.0
    second = -np.inf
    if np.sum(is_item) > 1:
        tmp = masked.copy()
        tmp[np.argmax(masked)] = -np.inf
        second = np.max(tmp)
    reference = second if np.isfinite(second) else 0.0
    edge = np.where(is_item, (rate_v - reference) / np.maximum(abs(best), 1e-3), 0.0)

    # also a soft survival gate: items that decay during the trip lose ground
    gate = survival * feasible.astype(float) * arrives_before_end.astype(float)

    item_score = np.tanh(edge) * gate
    # infeasible or too-late items: penalty scaled by value at stake
    bad = is_item & ((~feasible) | (~arrives_before_end))
    item_score = np.where(bad, -0.5 - 0.5 * survival, item_score)

    batt_at_charger = battery - d * drain
    low_batt = np.clip(1.0 - batt_at_charger / 0.35, 0.0, 1.0)
    any_reachable = np.any(is_item & feasible & arrives_before_end)
    stranded = 0.0 if any_reachable else 1.0
    defer = -0.5 * (1.0 - low_batt) * (1.0 if any_reachable else 0.0)
    charger_score = 2.0 * low_batt + 1.2 * stranded + defer

    score = np.where(is_item, item_score, charger_score)
    return np.tanh(score)

import numpy as np

def feature(pos, targets, values, rates, battery, drain, charge_rate, charger, time, time_left, history):
    """Endgame abandonment gain: for each item, arrival value per outbound time when the round-trip-plus-recharge no longer fits in time_left, otherwise a small negative standing for the cost of skipping the return discipline (so items that still allow a safe return are mildly deprioritised only when some endgame item exists); charger gets the residual slack signal."""
    d = np.linalg.norm(targets - pos[None, :], axis=1)
    is_item = values > 0

    d_back = np.linalg.norm(charger[None, :] - targets, axis=1)
    recharge_t = np.maximum(1.0 - battery, 0.0) / max(charge_rate, 1e-6)
    round_trip_fit = d + d_back + recharge_t

    v_arr = np.maximum(values - rates * d, 0.0)

    # endgame: the return trip can no longer be afforded before the horizon
    endgame = is_item & (time_left < round_trip_fit) & (d <= time_left)

    # outbound efficiency, log-squashed so scale is stable across families
    outbound_eff = np.log1p(v_arr / (d + 0.05))

    # how much slack is left relative to the outbound leg (0 = at the edge, 1 = plenty)
    slack = np.clip(1.0 - round_trip_fit / np.maximum(time_left, 1e-6), -1.0, 1.0)

    base = np.where(endgame, outbound_eff, 0.0)

    # if no endgame item exists, everyone scores 0 -> feature is inert outside endgame
    any_endgame = np.any(endgame)
    if any_endgame:
        # competing endgame efficiency reference
        ref = np.max(np.where(endgame, outbound_eff, -np.inf))
        ref = max(ref, 1e-6)
        base = np.where(endgame, outbound_eff / ref, 0.0)
        # items that still allow a return get a mildly negative, slack-scaled push
        non_end = is_item & ~endgame
        base = np.where(non_end, -0.5 * (0.5 + 0.5 * slack), base)

    # charger: when endgame items exist, the charger is less attractive (abandon return);
    # when nothing can be reached before the end, strong pull to the charger
    reachable = is_item & (d <= time_left) & (v_arr > 0)
    stranded = 0.0 if np.any(reachable) else 1.0
    charger_score = np.where(any_endgame, -0.7, 0.0) + 1.5 * stranded

    score = np.where(is_item, base, charger_score)
    return np.tanh(score)

import numpy as np

def feature(pos, targets, values, rates, battery, drain, charge_rate, charger, time, time_left, history):
    """Charger row: expected number of visible items reachable before a predicted lull ends, minus reach+charge cost, tanh-squashed; items 0."""
    k = targets.shape[0]
    out = np.zeros(k, dtype=float)
    charger_mask = (values == 0)
    if not np.any(charger_mask):
        return out
    dist = float(np.linalg.norm(pos - charger))
    # time to reach charger and top up
    commit = dist + (1.0 - battery) / max(charge_rate, 1e-6)

    # estimate a lull horizon from appearance history
    if history.shape[0] >= 6:
        t_app = history[:, 2]
        gaps = np.diff(t_app)
        recent = gaps[-12:] if gaps.size else np.array([0.0])
        med_gap = float(np.median(recent)) if recent.size else 0.0
        # typical wait until the next item given current lull length
        since_last = time - float(np.max(t_app)) if t_app.size else 0.0
        lull_horizon = max(med_gap - since_last, 0.0)
        # how many visible items will still be around after committing to charger
        is_item = values > 0
        if np.any(is_item):
            life = values / np.maximum(rates, 1e-6)
            surv = np.clip(1.0 - commit / np.maximum(life, 1e-6), 0.0, 1.0)
            # items that survive the round of charging and could be picked after
            n_surv = float(np.sum(surv * is_item))
        else:
            n_surv = 0.0
        # if a fresh burst is likely soon (short lull_horizon) and items survive, defer charger
        defer = np.tanh(3.0 * (commit - lull_horizon) / max(med_gap, 0.1))
        # blend: negative when we should wait for items, positive when charging is fine
        score = defer * (1.0 - np.clip(n_surv / 5.0, 0.0, 1.0)) + 0.3 * (1.0 - battery)
        out[charger_mask] = float(np.clip(score, -1.0, 1.0))
    else:
        # no history: pure battery/commit urgency
        out[charger_mask] = float(np.tanh(3.0 * (1.0 - battery / 0.35)))
    return np.nan_to_num(out, nan=0.0, posinf=1.0, neginf=-1.0)
features.measures: Charger row: expected number of visible items reachable before a predicted lull ends, minus reach+charge cost, tanh-squashed; items 0.

import numpy as np

def feature(pos, targets, values, rates, battery, drain, charge_rate, charger, time, time_left, history):
    """Per item: expected value destroyed at the charger if we go charge now (sum of projected decay of all other visible items over the recharge duration), relative to this item's own projected value; charger 0.
    Items whose current value dominates the opportunity cost of a recharge get high score; when recharging would waste a lot of other value, this item is deprioritised."""
    k = targets.shape[0]
    out = np.zeros(k, dtype=float)
    is_item = values > 0
    if not np.any(is_item):
        return out

    d = np.sqrt(np.maximum(((targets - pos) ** 2).sum(axis=1), 0.0))  # (k,)
    projected = np.where(is_item, np.maximum(values - rates * d, 0.0), 0.0)

    # recharge cost if we go to charger now: time to reach charger + recharge for spent energy
    d_charger = float(np.linalg.norm(charger - pos))
    energy_spent = d_charger * drain
    recharge_dur = energy_spent / max(charge_rate, 1e-3) + 1.0 / max(charge_rate, 1e-3)

    # value lost across all other items during that recharge window
    lost_others = np.sum(np.where(is_item, rates * recharge_dur, 0.0))

    # per item: its own projected value minus what a recharge would destroy (shared cost), normalised by max projected value
    own = projected
    denom = max(np.max(values[is_item]), 1e-6)
    score = (own - lost_others) / denom
    out = np.where(is_item, np.tanh(score), 0.0)
    return out
features.measures: Per item: expected value destroyed at the charger if we go charge now (sum of projected decay of all other visible items over the recharge duration), relative to this item's own projected value; charger 0.

import numpy as np

def feature(pos, targets, values, rates, battery, drain, charge_rate, charger, time, time_left, history):
    """Recency-weighted Gaussian kernel density of past arrival positions, weighted by appearance value, normalised and squashed."""
    k = targets.shape[0]
    if history.shape[0] == 0 or time <= 1e-6:
        return np.zeros(k)
    age = time - history[:, 2]
    w = np.maximum(0.0, 1.0 - age / 25.0)          # (s,)
    hpos = history[:, :2]                           # (s, 2)
    hval = history[:, 3]                            # (s,)
    sigma = 0.20
    # squared distances candidates x history
    d2 = ((targets[:, None, :] - hpos[None, :, :]) ** 2).sum(axis=2)  # (k, s)
    kern = np.exp(-d2 / (2.0 * sigma * sigma))      # (k, s)
    flux = (kern * (w * hval)[None, :]).sum(axis=1) # (k,)
    flux = flux / (2.0 * np.pi * sigma * sigma * 25.0)
    out = flux / (np.max(flux) + 1e-9)
    return np.tanh(3.0 * out)

import numpy as np

def feature(pos, targets, values, rates, battery, drain, charge_rate, charger, time, time_left, history):
    """Survival value per marginal detour distance to the charger, gated by battery deficit above 0.30, scaled to [-1,1]."""
    d = np.linalg.norm(targets - pos, axis=1)
    d_now_ch = np.linalg.norm(pos - charger)
    d_i_ch = np.linalg.norm(targets - charger, axis=1)
    detour = np.maximum(d + d_i_ch - d_now_ch, 0.0)
    surv = np.maximum(values - rates * d, 0.0)
    deficit = np.clip(1.0 - battery, 0.0, 1.0)
    gate = max(np.tanh(3.0 * (deficit - 0.30)), 0.0)
    if gate <= 0.0:
        return np.zeros_like(values)
    score = np.where(values > 0, surv / (detour + 0.05), 0.0)
    scale = np.max(score)
    if scale <= 1e-9:
        return np.zeros_like(values)
    return gate * score / scale

import numpy as np

def feature(pos, targets, values, rates, battery, drain, charge_rate, charger, time, time_left, history):
    """Best pair-tour value per (leg time + 4x forced recharge time), normalised to [0,1]; charger 0."""
    k = targets.shape[0]
    if k == 0:
        return np.zeros(0)

    # Distance from drone to each candidate
    diff = targets - pos[None, :]
    t_i = np.sqrt(np.sum(diff * diff, axis=1))  # (k,)

    # Survival of each item on direct arrival
    surv = np.maximum(values - rates * t_i, 0.0)  # (k,)

    # Pairwise distances between candidates
    d = targets[:, None, :] - targets[None, :, :]
    D = np.sqrt(np.sum(d * d, axis=2))  # (k, k)

    legs = t_i[:, None] + D  # (k, k): time to reach i then j

    # Survival of follow-up j after reaching i then flying to j
    arrival_j = t_i[:, None] + D
    surv_j = np.where(values[None, :] > 0,
                      np.maximum(values[None, :] - rates[None, :] * arrival_j, 0.0),
                      0.0)  # (k, k)
    pair = surv[:, None] + surv_j  # (k, k)

    # Drop i -> i
    legs_masked = legs.copy()
    np.fill_diagonal(legs_masked, np.inf)

    # Forced recharge time for the two-leg tour, exaggerated by 4
    forced = np.maximum(legs_masked * drain - battery, 0.0) / max(charge_rate, 1e-6)

    rate = pair / (legs_masked + 4.0 * forced + 0.05)  # (k, k)

    # Best follow-up per i (ignore inf legs)
    with np.errstate(invalid='ignore'):
        best_pair = np.max(np.where(np.isfinite(legs_masked), rate, -np.inf), axis=1)
    best_pair = np.where(np.isfinite(best_pair), best_pair, 0.0)

    # Single-stop alternative
    single = surv / (t_i + 0.05)

    best = np.maximum(best_pair, single)

    out = np.where(values > 0, np.maximum(best, 0.0), 0.0)

    scale = np.max(out) if out.size > 0 else 0.0
    if scale <= 1e-9:
        return np.zeros(k)
    return out / scale

nodes.title: Post-pickup repositioning cost
nodes.description: Arrival value divided by outbound travel time plus the distance from the candidate to the value-weighted centroid of the remaining visible items (battery-feasibility gated), so pickups that strand the drone away from future opportunity rank lower.

nodes.title: Reservation-price density
nodes.description: Item rows = survival-weighted value density minus an adaptive reservation price that rises when many feasible high-density items are visible and falls when the field is poor; charger row = 0, so the charger only wins in poor fields.

nodes.title: Battery-range risk aversion
nodes.description: Survival value per trip time multiplied by a convex penalty on the fraction of the remaining battery range the round trip consumes, so marginal long hops are taken only when clearly denser.

nodes.title: Anti-clustering outlier priority
nodes.description: Subtract from each candidate's density the value-weighted proximity of the other visible candidates, so an item inside a dense cluster (collectable on a later pass) loses to an isolated item of similar density.

nodes.title: Forecast arrival flux at charger
nodes.description: Score the charger row by predicted near-future arrival flux around the charger (recent arrival positions extrapolated) versus the current visible field density, so waits happen where the next burst will land.

nodes.title: Wave-phase density bar
nodes.description: Estimate instantaneous arrival/value flux from history and shift each item's required density threshold with it: pickier during bursts, charger-friendly in lulls.

nodes.title: Charger-detour pickup
nodes.description: When a recharge trip is due, score items by value-at-arrival divided by the extra detour time beyond the direct pos-to-charger leg, so near-free pickups on the way win.

nodes.title: Two-step rollout of density
nodes.description: Score each candidate by its own density plus the best density reachable from it after pickup (one champion-style rollout step), so targets that leave good follow-ups win.

nodes.title: Three-stop chain tour rate
nodes.description: Extend the kept two-stop tour to a best feasible three-stop chain: total surviving value over the three legs' time, so the drone accepts a weaker first item when the chain after it is much stronger.

nodes.title: Recharge-amortised pair tour
nodes.description: Two-stop tour value divided by both flight legs plus the charging time the tour forces, so pairs that leave the battery low are priced by the charger trip they create.

nodes.title: Greedy portfolio marginal value
nodes.description: Score each candidate by its marginal contribution to a greedy time-and-energy-budgeted selection over all visible items, so the pick is judged as part of a schedule rather than as a single or pairwise trip.

nodes.title: Wave-rhythm pre-charging
nodes.description: Estimate the arrival rhythm from history (inter-arrival gap autocorrelation) and raise the charger row in predicted lulls while suppressing it in predicted bursts, so the drone tops up before a wave instead of during one.

nodes.title: Abundance-adaptive pickiness
nodes.description: Scale every item's score by a pickiness factor that falls with the number of battery-feasible visible items, so the drone takes mediocre targets only when the board is thin and saves battery otherwise.

nodes.title: Burst/lull regime switch
nodes.description: Detect burst vs lull phases from history arrival rate and switch scoring regime: during bursts use short-range dense picks and zero the charger row; during lulls favour charging/repositioning.

nodes.title: Excursion energy budget
nodes.description: Set a target excursion length (radius/energy) per trip from drain, charge_rate and observed arrival flux, then strongly prefer items inside that budget instead of penalising each item.

nodes.title: Instance-adaptive time discount
nodes.description: Estimate the instance's typical decay rate and arrival flux from history and set the travel-time discount used in the density accordingly, instead of a fixed rate.

nodes.title: Future-arrival positioning
nodes.description: Score each candidate by the predicted future value flux in its neighbourhood (recent history arrival positions extrapolated), so a pickup leaves the drone where new value will soon appear rather than chasing visible items only.

nodes.title: Battery-conditional charger geography
nodes.description: Multiply arrival-value density by a penalty that grows with the candidate's distance from the charger only as battery falls, so far items are served on a full battery and near-charger items late in a cycle, cutting charge time.
